title: {project} — design inventory
subtitle: Every color, size, spacing, radius, shadow and form control in the code, at real size.

cover.no_model: Inventory only — diagnosis and proposals need an agent: run /design-polish
cover.no_engine: values not compiled — no Tailwind v4 engine found; looks are keyed by class names

summary.score_help: Share of style occurrences that go through a token or the scale, weighted by count. Not an aesthetic score.
summary.good_axis: {axis}: {score}% of {n} occurrences use tokens or the scale — no change proposed.
summary.good_none: No axis is fully consistent yet.
summary.glossary_h: Four words used in this report
glossary: a named value defined once (a CSS variable like --color-brand) that the code refers to instead of typing the value
a value typed directly where it is used (#1AA44D, 18px); it cannot be changed in one place
one distinct combination of styles for a control; 47 buttons with 5 looks means 5 rows here
a page of the app; every item lists the screens it appears on, so you can check it by eye
summary.headline_default: {project}: {looks} component looks across {types} types, {hardcoded} raw colors, {findings} findings.

screens.help: Screens found from the router. Every value and look below lists the screens it appears on.
screens.none: No router detected. Items are attributed to files instead of screens.

color.declared_help: Tokens the project defines. Uses counts every class or rule that refers to the token.
color.cluster_help: Colors a viewer cannot tell apart, shown edge to edge. ΔE is the perceptual distance (CIEDE2000); below 1 is invisible, below 2 needs a side-by-side.

typography.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

components.catalog_only: {n} looks appear only on catalog pages
components.render_failed: Real rendering unavailable ({reason}) — classes shown instead

relations.help: Controls that sit in one row or grid. Values are legal on their own; they should still match their neighbours.

proposal.help: Derived from what the code already uses. Nothing here is applied until you choose it.
proposal.none: No proposal yet — run /design-polish in your agent.

cards.help: Each card is one safe-to-review change. Choose rows above or add a card's recommendation here. Nothing is pre-selected.
cards.none: No cards yet — run /design-polish in your agent.

delta.none: After you apply cards and re-scan (npx design-polish recheck), this chapter shows what changed.
delta.conditions: Compared with run {baseline} · same scanner: {same} · {filesBefore} → {filesAfter} code files
delta.tokens_h: Tokens in force after this run

method.coverage_text: {scanned} of {listed} files scanned ({source}); {failed} failed to parse; {dynamic} dynamic class sites; {unresolved} unresolved classes.
method.score_formula: Score per axis = occurrences through tokens or the scale ÷ all occurrences. Composite = count-weighted mean. Components = occurrences that use one of the base component's looks ÷ all.
method.fonts: Specimens use the fonts installed on this machine; the project's web fonts are substituted when they cannot be embedded.
honesty: Numbers come from scripts, not from a language model.
Specimens are rendered with the project's own compiled CSS; nothing is imitated.
Unresolved values are listed, never estimated.
This report was built offline; it makes no network requests.

curation.copied: Decisions copied — paste them into your agent
curation.saved: Saved decisions.json — hand it to your agent

cart.warn_m: That is a lot for one pass; splitting across two runs keeps each review careful.
cart.warn_l: Too much for one pass. Start with the safe cards; the rest in a second run.
cart.warn_mixed: Safe and visible changes are mixed; consider sending the safe ones first.

misc.search: Find a value, token or screen
